projects.title: AI Startup — Strategic Market Consulting
projects.summary: An academic consulting engagement for an early-stage AI company developing automated image-processing and synthetic-data solutions. The project evaluated potential industry verticals and developed a focused market-prioritisation and go-to-market recommendation.

challenge.text: The startup operated in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market where broad technical capability did not automatically create a defensible market position. The central challenge was to identify a vertical where customer pain, market attractiveness, adoption readiness, regulatory conditions, and implementation feasibility could support stronger differentiation.
challenge.quote: Which market vertical should the company prioritise to achieve stronger differentiation and scalable growth?

approach.intro: The team compared potential applications through one structured decision framework rather than selecting a market based only on headline size.

research.title: Market and vertical research
research.content: We researched multiple potential applications and compared the commercial logic of each vertical, including customer pain, demand maturity, market structure, and the role synthetic data could play.

research.title: Competitive benchmarking
research.content: We assessed direct competitors, adjacent solutions, positioning gaps, and the degree to which vertical specialisation could create a clearer value proposition.

research.title: Feasibility and adoption
research.content: We considered regulation, data access, technical integration, adoption readiness, implementation complexity, and the risks associated with entering each market.

logicFlow.title: Customer Pain
logicFlow.text: Start with a clearly defined, high-urgency customer problem.

logicFlow.title: Tech Role
logicFlow.text: Ensure synthetic data plays a relevant, core technological role.

logicFlow.title: Business Value
logicFlow.text: Demonstrate clear, quantifiable economic value for adopters.

logicFlow.title: Adoption Reality
logicFlow.text: Validate realistic compliance, data access, and integration friction.

logicFlow.title: Defensible Differentiation
logicFlow.text: Establish a specialized, defensible barrier against horizontal players.

strategicRecommendation.headline: Shift from broad horizontal competition to focused vertical specialisation.
principles: Prioritise a clearer, high-value vertical use case
Align tech capabilities with market demand and adoption reality
Reduce go-to-market ambiguity through focused positioning

roadmap.title: Validation
roadmap.description: Validate customer pain, use cases, technical requirements, and buying logic.

roadmap.title: Pilot Design
roadmap.description: Define a focused pilot, success criteria, and technical and commercial validation requirements.

roadmap.title: Focused Market Entry
roadmap.description: Refine positioning, target segments, messaging, and initial customer-acquisition priorities.

roadmap.title: Expansion
roadmap.description: Scale after evidence of product–market fit and repeatable implementation.

independentlyLed: TAM / SAM / SOM market sizing and prioritization logic
Positioning-gap analysis vs direct and adjacent competitors
Structuring the final executive analytical storyline
Presenting and defending the strategic recommendation directly to the CEO
contributedTo: Demand, regulation, and implementation friction comparison

outcome.text: The final analysis and recommendation were presented directly to the CEO. During the Q&A, the team defended the evidence, trade-offs, assumptions, implementation risks, and feasibility of the proposed direction.
outcome.disclaimer: The project delivered a validated strategic direction and an actionable roadmap. It did not include measured post-launch commercial results.

seo.title: AI Startup Strategic Market Consulting | Elena Krayneva
seo.description: Academic consulting project evaluating market verticals, competitive positioning, adoption barriers, and a phased go-to-market strategy for an early-stage AI startup.

projects.title: Digify Active — B2B Growth & Marketing Analytics
projects.summary: A team-based academic project that developed and tested a B2B marketing-agency concept for small and medium-sized fitness businesses, connecting market strategy, HubSpot landing pages, Google Ads, conversion tracking, and performance analysis.

metadataStrip.label: Methods
metadataStrip.value: Positioning, funnel design, Google Ads, analysis

challenge.text: Many small and medium-sized fitness businesses lacked a structured approach to digital acquisition. The project needed to create a differentiated B2B service proposition and connect it to a realistic path from initial awareness to lead submission.
challenge.quote: How can a new B2B marketing service attract and convert SME fitness businesses through a structured digital acquisition funnel?

foundation.title: Market gap
foundation.content: The team identified a gap between the growth needs of SME fitness businesses and their ability to build consistent digital-marketing systems.

foundation.title: Target segment and positioning
foundation.content: Defined a target segment, customer needs, value proposition, and service positioning designed around the constraints of smaller fitness businesses.

foundation.title: Pricing logic
foundation.content: Pricing was developed as part of the service concept and aligned with the target market and proposed offer.

journeySteps.name: Paid Advertisement
journeySteps.desc: Google Ads Search & Display campaign touchpoint

journeySteps.name: Lead-Capture Form
journeySteps.desc: Structured qualification and lead submission flow

performanceMetrics.detail: Click-through rate measurement across ad formats

strategicRecommendation.headline: Build acquisition around intent-led targeting and an end-to-end conversion funnel.
principles: Align ad messaging directly with landing-page offer
Improve hero clarity to capture instant visitor interest
Refine search keyword targeting to reduce wasted spend
Eliminate form friction to reduce mid-funnel drop-offs
Tighten follow-up communication to improve lead conversion

optimisationGrid.action: Refine keyword match types & exclude irrelevant query themes
Reallocate budget toward high-intent Search keywords
Streamline hero copy and bring form fields above the fold
Match ad headline text directly to landing-page headers
Automate instant email confirmation with next steps

independentlyLed: Building conversion-focused landing pages and lead-capture forms in HubSpot
Structuring the end-to-end user path from ad click to lead submission
Analyzing funnel drop-off points across landing page interactions
contributedTo: Market and target-audience research for SME fitness operators
Developing B2B positioning and value proposition
Supporting Google Ads Search and Display campaign execution
CTR, CPA, and channel performance comparison

outcome.text: The project moved from market analysis and positioning to a functioning B2B acquisition model with a live website, lead-capture structure, paid campaign testing, and performance analysis.
outcome.disclaimer: The test generated evidence about channel and funnel behaviour and produced recommendations for the next optimisation cycle. It did not represent a scaled commercial agency.

projects.title: Oblicuo Hi-Fi Bar — Customer Research & Growth Strategy
projects.summary: A customer-insights and strategy project for a Barcelona listening bar, focused on increasing Tuesday–Thursday visits while preserving its premium, intimate, and locally relevant identity.

challenge.text: Oblicuo had strong brand authenticity but inconsistent early-week attendance and limited structured digital strategy. The goal was not maximum reach. Broad visibility could attract poorly matched audiences and weaken the experience that differentiated the venue.
challenge.quote: How could the venue increase Tuesday–Thursday visits without losing its premium, intimate, and locally relevant identity?

keyInsights.headline: Validation over discovery
keyInsights.detail: Social media often validated a choice rather than created initial discovery. Customers checked social channels to confirm atmosphere before going out.

keyInsights.headline: Uncertainty barrier
keyInsights.detail: The main visit barrier was uncertainty about crowd level, noise, seating availability, and early-evening vibe.

keyInsights.headline: Segmented value drivers
keyInsights.detail: Different customer segments valued the Hi-Fi concept for distinct reasons (audiophiles vs casual socializers vs design enthusiasts).

keyInsights.headline: Predictability requirement
keyInsights.detail: Weekday demand required predictability and comfortable atmosphere rather than weekend hype or packed crowds.

spotlightSegment.title: Priority Segment: The After-Work Neighbor
spotlightSegment.desc: A nearby professional looking for one high-quality drink and comfortable conversation without planning a late night out.
spotlightSegment.need: Wants a calm, predictable, conversation-friendly environment after work.
spotlightSegment.communication: Clear visual signals showing early-evening seating, relaxed noise levels, and effortless walk-in convenience.

journeyStages.name: Consideration
journeyStages.desc: Checking social media to verify atmosphere & crowd

journeyStages.name: Venue Experience
journeyStages.desc: Enjoying Hi-Fi sound, curated drinks & conversation

journeyStages.name: Loyalty
journeyStages.desc: Becoming a regular weekday neighbor visitor

strategicRecommendation.headline: Use social media as a risk-reduction tool for weekday visits.
principles: Reduce customer uncertainty around seating and atmosphere
Show real early-evening conditions to set clear expectations
Reinforce local neighborhood relevance and convenience
Make weekday visits feel easy, accessible, and repeatable
Protect the venue's premium, intimate 'hidden-gem' identity

independentlyLed: Developing the detailed implementation layer for the 'After-Work Neighbor' segment
Formulating behavioral objectives & content creation principles
Structuring timing logic & the 3-month tactical content calendar
Creating specific post, story, and video content concepts
contributedTo: Overall growth strategy and KPI measurement tree

outcome.text: The project established a clearly defined priority segment for weekday growth and delivered a data-backed strategy grounded in direct customer evidence.
outcome.disclaimer: These were strategic deliverables and proposed indicators, not measured post-implementation commercial results.

seo.title: Oblicuo Customer Research & Growth Strategy | Elena Krayneva
seo.description: Customer-insights project using 16 interviews, audience segmentation, customer journeys, behavioural barriers, growth strategy, and a KPI framework for weekday visits.
